movelist.name: Iron Tail
movelist.effect: Iron Tail lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 15+.

movelist.name: Crunch
movelist.effect: Crunch lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+

movelist.name: Rock Slide
movelist.effect: Rock Slide Flinches all Legal Targets on 17+.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Slam
movelist.effect: Slam may be used as a Free Action at the end of a Sprint Maneuver taken as a Standard Action, as long as the user Shifted at least 3 meters in a straight line towards the target. When used this way, Slam gains the Smite keyword.

movelist.name: Dragon Breath
movelist.effect: Dragon Breath Paralyzes the Target on 15+.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Moves with the Execute Keyword. If a single source of Damage or Hit Point Loss would cause the user to lose more than X Hit Points, the damage or Hit Point loss is instead reduced to X. X is equal to 50% of their Max Hit Points. Defensive.

abilities.name: Battle Armor
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Critical Hits; they are instead normal hits. Defensive.

abilities.name: Rock Head
abilities.effect: The user ignores the Recoil keyword when attacking. If the user moves at least 4 meters in a straight line towards a foe before attacking that foe with a physical attack, they may add a +2d6 Bonus to the Damage Roll against that foe.
